services.heading: What I can offer
services.worldbuilding: I can offer you professional world design for any story, comic, or game. I specialize in fantasy worldbuilding, but I have experience with soft sci‑fi worlds as well. Besides creating a world from scratch to your liking, I also have experience with world design consultations and continuing an existing worldbuilding project.
services.writing: I can offer you my writing skills in the areas of niche blog writing, academic writing, and technical writing. I have university education in the English language and I have been writing informational articles about worldbuilding, writing, and coding on my blog since 2019. I can also serve as a proofreader and a style checker (I have experience with the MLA and APA formats).
services.coding: I can offer you software engineering of static websites, complex web apps, Discord bots, and many other projects. I've been in the industry for over 7 years, working with many incredibly diverse technologies in teams of various sizes. Through my industry experience, I can guarantee that the code I deliver will be readable, functional, and effective.
services.ai: Read my statement on [AI and AI-based projects](/ai).

coding.heading: Coding projects
coding.description: Check out some of my favorite and most recent coding projects. My writing & worldbuilding projects are listed below.

eledris.title: Eledris
eledris.imgAlt: An illustration of several floating crystals, representative of the magic on the Eledris fantasy world.
eledris.description: Eledris is my personal worldbuilding project. It's a grimdark fantasy setting whose inhabitants need to fight for their survival as the planet is under siege by the demonic hordes. When writing worldbuilding articles, I always showcase a part of Eledris to give worldbuilders some inspiration. Working on Eledris ignited my passion for worldbuilding, which I channel into my freelance world design projects.

artprompts.title: Art Prompts
artprompts.imgAlt: An illustration of a mobile phone with the Art Prompts logo on its screen on top of a blank page of paper with a pencil.
artprompts.description: Art Prompts is one of my largest personal projects -- it's a fullstack web application designed inspire artists to draw every day. The project includes a website, web app (600+ registered users), internal API, a Discord bot (7k+ servers), and more. Implementing the project included longterm project management, payment gate integration, OAuth2 implementation, and other complex features.

plagues.title: On Worldbuilding and Plagues
plagues.imgAlt: An illustration of a diseased rat.
plagues.description: *On Worldbuilding and Plagues* is a 2.3k word article I wrote for my worldbuilding blog, Eledris. The article details how pandemics form, what impact they have on societies, and provides some useful examples of real-world plagues for wordbuilders.

palettey.title: Palettey
palettey.description: Palettey is a Discord bot for generating color palettes based on an input color. It implements multiple palette-generating algorithms. The bot is coded in PHP and the DiscordPHP library.

eledrisblog.title: The Eledris Blog
eledrisblog.description: The Eledris Blog is a resource dedicated to worldbuilders. I started the blog back in 2019, and since then, I've been writing articles for it whenever I have a bit of time to spare. To date, I've written over 50 articles, and the blog is visited by around 100 people a day. In late 2026, I'm planning on working on a revamped version of the blog.

forsakenland.title: Forsakenland
forsakenland.imgAlt: An illustration of a whale-shaped spaceship.
forsakenland.description: Forsakenland is a work-in-progress grimdark sci‑fi game inspired by the world of Warhammer 40k. On this project, I work as the lead freelance world designer, creating the setting of Gylesian‑3C, a desert planet. I've created about 25 pages of notes so far; a sample can be seen by clicking the button below.

freelanceworldbuilding.title: Freelance World Design
freelanceworldbuilding.description: I've been a part of many world design projects as a freelance consultant. Some of these projects included creating original magic systems, history, and geography.

wumpi.title: Wumpi
wumpi.description: Wumpi (n. plural of *Wumpus*) is a series of open-source Discord bots that I'm releasing on my GitHub profile. They enable users to easily set up their own simple utility bots for simple tasks such as welcoming new members, rolling DnD dice, and post cute ASCII art.

starfall.title: Starfall
starfall.description: Starfall was a Czech blog dedicated to user-friendly guides and news articles around the game World of Warcraft that I used to write for. While the blog unfortunately doesn't run anymore, it served as a valuable experience in writing about video games and working with content management systems.

keywords.title: czech-keywords
keywords.description: czech-keywords is a keyword extraction tool written in Perl. It runs using a custom-modified formula based on the tf–idf algorithm. The entire source code, as well as documentation in both English and Czech can be found on GitHub.

prideflags.title: Pride Flags & Gradients
prideflags.description: Pride Flags & Gradients is a queer-themed plugin for the design software Figma. It allows users to input various pride flags and pride-themed CSS gradients into their designs. The plugin is coded in TypeScript using React.

trezor.title: Trezor
trezor.imgAlt: The homepage of the Trezor website, a neobrutalist pink digital archive search page.
trezor.description: Trezor is a non-profit project I'm working on; it's a Czech digital archive of academic works with queer topics that are in danger of being censored. I'm the lead developer of this project, designing the entire architecture and implementing the server, website, and back-end of the system. Public access to the website is currently limited, but I'm working on writing a short case study about it.

hkskins.title: HKSkins
hkskins.imgAlt: A screenshot of the HKSkins website, showcasing a grid of skins for the game Hollow Knight.
hkskins.description: HKSkins is a website compiling an organized list of user-created skins for the games *Hollow Knight (2017)* and *Hollow Knight: Silksong (2025)*. The website runs on Gatsby.js and utilizes GraphQL to display and sort individual skins based on metadata in JSON files in the project's filesystem. HKSkins is by far my most visited website, with around 3 000 visitors a day.

terapielang.title: Terapie Lang website
terapielang.description: Terapie Lang is a website designed in a simplistic watercolor style for a client's therapy practice. This small project was an entertaining challenge in creating a useful website while matching the client's desired visual style.

homelab.title: Homelab
homelab.description: I selfhost around 40 services and websites for personal and professional use on a series of servers at home. This long-term project taught me many skills in server administration, especially with the Proxmox virtualization platform and with Docker. I'm planning on releasing a longer article on the homelab soon!

bestdivadlo.title: BEST website
bestdivadlo.description: The Brno English Speaking Theater (BEST) is an amateur theater company in Brno, Czech Republic. I coded a small website for the company using Ghost as the content management system, allowing the company members to update the website easily without needing much of my input. The website will become public around the end of 2026.

portfolio.title: Portfolio website
portfolio.description: This portfolio site is coded in the 11ty static site generator, allowing me to edit a lot of the content using Markdown. The source code is available on GitHub!

jeremiahgigowski.text: This app is truly one of the best art prompt apps out there, it has unique ideas and phrases that really can make you feel inspired!

aloispribyl.text: Tadeas is an exceptionally reliable and devoted employee, capable of developing projects independently, looking for opportunities for innovation, and offering functional, future-proof solutions to problems. Their best quality is their communication skills: they are capable of explaining complex technical concepts even to a layperson using clear and understandable language. contact.heading: Contact me
contact.description: Let's chat! I'm open to work as a full-stack web developer for React and Node.js projects. In a freelance capacity, I also offer work in world design, academic and other non-fiction writing, coding Discord bots, and more. You can reach me over email at contact@tadeasjun.com. If you want to learn more about me before reaching out, [check out my CV](/assets/pdf/tadeasjun_cv_en.pdf). I also occasionally hang out on social media; you can click the links below to reach me there.

blog.heading: Blog posts
blog.description: I write world design and writing articles over on [the Eledris Blog](https://eledris.com). Each article on Eledris takes about 200 hours of work. To take a break from articles that take so much work, and to allow myself to temporarily leave the worldbuilding niche, I've created this small blog to host my simpler articles, mainly focused on programming, freelancing, and case studies.

now.lastUpdate: I've last updated this page on:

september2026.title: September 2026
september2026.content: This September, I've been preparing for the final parts of the year. After putting it off for several months, I've finally finished up revamping the Twitch bot for Art Prompts, which is one of the final large features I've been wanting to finish for that project. At work, I'm also wrapping up a couple of large features. Finally, I'm preparing for writing the second half of my Master's thesis, which I need to finish by the end of November. To make sure I take breaks from work, I've also been watching a lot of movies.

october2026.title: October 2026
october2026.content: In October, I'm continuing to tie up loose ends for the year. I'll be traveling to Germany for a week to focus on writing my Master's thesis, hoping that I will at least mostly finish it by the end of the month. Besides that, I'm learning to work with Playwright for writing automated tests, at the moment mostly for Art Prompts. My goal is to make the project as stable as possible into the upcoming year, because I'm not sure how much free time I'll have in 2027 to be working on it. On the side, I would like to continue working on this website in order to finish implemented the remaining `/pages` I haven't looked at yet.

about.heading: About me
about.introduction: Hi, I'm Tadeas! I'm a senior software engineer based in Brno, Czech Republic. I create websites from start to finish, both commercially and as a hobby. The homepage of this website contains my portfolio, so I would refer you to that if you're looking for a web developer. This page is written in a more informal style, and is meant for visitors of my website that aren't necessarily looking for engineers to hire.
about.softwareEngineering: In my day-to-day, I mostly go by Tad, so you can call me that! I like tinkering, which is how a lot of my personal projects started, including my largest website, Art Prompts, and my most popular one, HKSkins. In that vein, I also run a homeserver where I self-host a bunch of various open-source services, for personal and professional use. On this website, I write a small blog about tech and whatever comes to mind on a given week.
about.literature: I love literature, having studied literary analysis for my Bachelor's and Master's degree. I'm interested in queer representation and post-colonial literatures. My top recommendation is Split Tooth by Tanya Tagaq.
about.community: I put a lot of emphasis on community -- in my personal life, I value my friends and everyone else around me, and I try to reflect this value in my projects, which always try to improve the lives of people.
